patch_description:
Redesign the ANSATZ_SPEC inside the EVOLVE-BLOCK to improve generalization and validation performance by increasing parameter sharing and stabilizing training. The new structure keeps the same overall data flow and measurement scheme, but:
- Adds a ring CZ entanglement on the outer qubits (perimeter) for richer passband connectivity.
- Introduces a ring CRX entanglement on the same perimeter using a single shared parameter (crx_ring) for parameter efficiency.
- Replaces hub-to-center entanglement from CRY to CRZ with a single shared parameter (crz_hub_edge) across all hub edges, improving stability.
- Maintains pre/post RZ layers and RY layers with symmetry-based parameter sharing.
- Keeps the per-block, per-upload/repetition parameter copies as required by the original design and preserves all inputs/outputs.

This structure aims to achieve higher validation accuracy and improved generalization with modestly increased expressivity and a controlled parameter budget.
